description: A pedagogical framework for teaching personal preferences using preference verbs + -ing and connectors, designed for A1-A2 students with some base knowledge

core_structure.pedagogical_approach: Communicative language teaching with preference-based personal introduction
core_structure.key_methodology: Using known structures for more intentional, connected, and spontaneous speaking

lesson_phases.name: Personalized Multiple Choice
lesson_phases.objective: Activate prior knowledge and introduce target vocabulary naturally

structure.format: Look at two options and answer, or say 'None, I...' and complete

sample_questions.question: What's your full name?
sample_questions.model_answer: None. My full name is [student's name].

sample_questions.question: What do you like to do in your free time?

lesson_phases.name: Target Vocabulary Introduction
lesson_phases.objective: Present and practice theme-specific vocabulary in categories

structure.instructions: Match activities with adjectives that represent YOUR opinion
structure.materials: Visual cards with activities and adjectives

lesson_phases.name: Grammar Presentation and Practice
lesson_phases.objective: Present and practice preference verbs + -ing + connectors

examples: I like swimming because it's relaxing
I like hiking because it's healthy and adventurous
I like reading, but I don't like watching TV

practice_activity.format: Complete sentences using emojis as clues
practice_activity.example: Maria: I like ______ 🥾 because it is ______ 🧘 and ______ 💪

prompts: Tell me 3 things you enjoy doing and why
Tell me something you hate and explain why
structure.target_output: Extended responses using target grammar and vocabulary

lesson_phases.name: Role-play: New in a Group
lesson_phases.objective: Integrate all lesson elements in realistic context

structure.scenario: Introduce yourself to a new group (conversation club, yoga class, etc.)
required_elements: Use of target grammar and vocabulary

review_questions: Which verbs do we use followed by -ing when talking about likes and dislikes?
How would you describe activities using fun, relaxing, exciting, boring?
Say something your family member likes and doesn't like
structure.motivational_closing: Your likes make you unique — and now you can share them in English!

extension_activities.name: Idiomatic Expressions Extension
extension_activities.content: Piece of cake / Not my cup of tea
extension_activities.application: Use expressions with activities for natural language development

assessment_criteria: Effective use of connectors (because, and, but)
Ability to give reasons for preferences

framework_metadata.created_for: A1-A2 students with base knowledge needing fluency development
framework_metadata.pedagogical_principle: Use known structures for more intentional communication
framework_metadata.scalability: High - adaptable to multiple themes and levels
